This update improves Undo, brush behaviour and the Mesh Warp and Liquify tools.

## Editing improvements

Undo now follows the same path from the keyboard, menus and toolbar. By default, it discards an unapplied canvas preview and undoes the last committed edit. If you prefer stepping through individual tool adjustments first, there is a new option under Preferences > Editing.

Brush clicks and strokes have more consistent deposits and pixel alignment. The brush outline remains visible outside the image, tool options keep a steadier layout, and brush-tip selection and cancellation are improved.

These improvements relate to issues 223, 224, 225 and 226.

## Mesh Warp and Liquify

Mesh Warp now lets you place reference points in Edit mesh mode before deforming the image. Reset removes the deformation while keeping those points.

Liquify has its own size and strength controls, Reconstruct, and selection protection. Its Reset keeps protected areas. Both tools have improved handling for fast drags, applying changes and switching tools.

## Help and other changes

A new Quick start guide walks through opening, editing and saving images, with links to AI setup, Preferences and Keybinds. Full documentation opens paintfe.com/docs. Straighten Canvas is under Canvas > Rotate Canvas.

This update also includes tablet-pressure settings and diagnostics, Italian label improvements, refreshed documentation, more reliable AVIF source verification and GitHub Actions dependency updates.
